answer: No agent joins the trusted set for free: a refundable stake bond unlocks only as independent peers attest real work over many epochs, so a brand-new account starts at a hollow near-zero weight. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly. Honest standing hardens slowly like a coral reef, while a correlated swarm of sockpuppets betrays itself as one lockstep whisper and forfeits its collateral.
